# ToolGarden — llms.txt

> A free collection of browser-based JSON processing tools. Tool inputs are processed locally in the browser and are not uploaded to the server, making the workflows privacy-friendly for sensitive snippets and files.

## What is ToolGarden?

ToolGarden provides developers with a suite of tools for working with JSON data. All tools run entirely in the browser using client-side JavaScript to reduce upload exposure and protect private work data.

<!-- registry-tools:start -->
## Registry Tool Index

> Generated from `lib/tools/registry.ts` and `messages/*.json` during `npm run build`.

### Format / 格式化

- **JSON Formatter / JSON 格式化** (`/json-format`): Free online JSON / JSONC / JSON5 formatter to format, minify, and validate data with comments, trailing commas, tree view, and node operations
  - English: https://toolgarden.xyz/en/json-format
  - Chinese: https://toolgarden.xyz/zh/json-format
- **JSON Escape / JSON 压缩转义** (`/json-escape`): Free online JSON escape tool to minify and escape JSON / JSONC / JSON5 for embedding in strings, or unescape back
  - English: https://toolgarden.xyz/en/json-escape
  - Chinese: https://toolgarden.xyz/zh/json-escape
- **JSON Repair / Clean / JSON 修复清洗** (`/json-repair`): Free online JSONC / JSON5 repair tool for comments, trailing commas, single quotes, unquoted keys, and other common JSON issues
  - English: https://toolgarden.xyz/en/json-repair
  - Chinese: https://toolgarden.xyz/zh/json-repair
- **JSON Diff / JSON 对比** (`/json-diff`): Free online JSON / JSONC / JSON5 diff tool to visually compare two documents, highlighting additions, removals, and changes
  - English: https://toolgarden.xyz/en/json-diff
  - Chinese: https://toolgarden.xyz/zh/json-diff
- **Text Diff / 文本对比** (`/text/diff`): Free online text diff using an open-source diff algorithm to highlight line and word changes
  - English: https://toolgarden.xyz/en/text/diff
  - Chinese: https://toolgarden.xyz/zh/text/diff
- **Whiteboard / 白板工具** (`/other/whiteboard`): Create a full local whiteboard with tldraw, including shapes, drawing, notes, images, pages, and export
  - English: https://toolgarden.xyz/en/other/whiteboard
  - Chinese: https://toolgarden.xyz/zh/other/whiteboard
- **Excalidraw Board / Excalidraw画板** (`/other/excalidraw-board`): Draw a local hand-drawn style board with open-source Excalidraw, including shapes, text, images, and export
  - English: https://toolgarden.xyz/en/other/excalidraw-board
  - Chinese: https://toolgarden.xyz/zh/other/excalidraw-board
- **Mind Map / 思维导图** (`/other/mind-map`): Edit mind maps directly with the open-source Mind Elixir library and export a Markdown outline
  - English: https://toolgarden.xyz/en/other/mind-map
  - Chinese: https://toolgarden.xyz/zh/other/mind-map

## Available Tools

- **Developer Blog** (`/blog`): Articles about JSON, JSONC, JSON5, frontend toolchains, browser-local processing, privacy-friendly workflows, and developer productivity.
  - **How I Built a Fully Browser-Local Online Toolkit** (`/blog/how-i-built-browser-local-online-tool-site`): Explains why ToolGarden was built as a no-upload, browser-local tool site, covering static Next.js architecture, pure utility functions, Workers, Canvas, Web Crypto, WASM, local AI, and privacy tradeoffs.
  - **How to Choose ID Photo Size and Background** (`/blog/make-id-photo-online-size-background-guide`): Covers China 1-inch, China 2-inch, China passport/travel document, U.S. passport 2 x 2 inch, background colors, official source links, and when digital edits are not appropriate.
  - **How Does Online Image Watermark Removal Work with Local AI Inpainting?** (`/blog/remove-image-watermark-local-ai-inpainting`): Explains browser-local watermark removal, AI inpainting, selection masks, suitable watermark areas, and limitations.
  - **How to Add Text, Image, Tiled, and Diagonal Watermarks to Images** (`/blog/add-watermark-to-image-text-tile-diagonal`): Covers text and image watermarks, nine-grid placement, tiling, diagonal layout, opacity, rotation, and output format choices.
  - **How One-Click Background Removal Works with a Browser-Local Model** (`/blog/remove-image-background-browser-local-model`): Explains foreground segmentation, alpha masks, transparent PNG export, local model processing, and edge-quality limits.
  - **Base64 Encoding Explained and Common Pitfalls** (`/blog/base64-encoding-explained-common-pitfalls`): Explains Base64, Data URLs, raw Base64, URL-safe Base64, size overhead, copy errors, and why Base64 is not encryption.
  - **LRC vs SRT Subtitle Formats and Online Editing** (`/blog/lrc-vs-srt-subtitle-format-edit-online`): Compares LRC and SRT timing structures, use cases, online editing, media preview, calibration, and export.
  - **How to Convert Excel Data to JSON Online** (`/blog/convert-excel-data-to-json-online`): Explains Excel-to-JSON conversion, headers, rows, empty cells, dates, first-sheet behavior, and data cleanup.
  - **How Text Diff Algorithms Find Additions, Deletions, and Changes** (`/blog/text-diff-algorithm-add-delete-change`): Explains line diff, word diff, sequence alignment, common subsequence ideas, and JSON structured comparison.
  - **What Is the Difference Between JSON, JSON5, and JSONC?** (`/blog/json-json5-jsonc-differences`): Compares strict JSON, JSONC comments, JSON5 JavaScript-like syntax, and when to convert back to standard JSON.
  - **How to Convert Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Images to PDF for Free** (`/blog/convert-word-excel-ppt-image-to-pdf-free`): Explains browser-local PDF conversion for Office files, images, text, Markdown, HTML, and output checks.
  - **How to Merge Multiple PDFs While Keeping Page Order and Checking Bookmarks** (`/blog/merge-multiple-pdf-files-keep-order-bookmarks`): Covers PDF merge order, drag sorting, page checks, and bookmark/outline compatibility review.

  - **Chinese vs English Text Counting** (`/blog/chinese-english-word-count-character-byte`): Explains characters, words, bytes, emoji, spaces, punctuation, and UTF-8 differences across Chinese and English text.

  - **How to Compress an Image to a Target File Size** (`/blog/compress-image-to-target-size`): Practical workflow for reaching 200KB, 500KB, 1MB, or other limits by adjusting dimensions, format, and quality.
  - **Why Does a Favicon Look Blurry?** (`/blog/why-favicon-looks-blurry`): Explains why favicons become soft or fuzzy and how multi-size ICO generation, transparency, and clean source images keep website icons sharp.
  - **How to Convert an Image to ICO** (`/blog/convert-image-to-ico`): Complete PNG, JPG, WebP, and SVG to ICO workflow covering browser-local decoding, Canvas rendering, ICO directory entries, and favicon usage.
  - **ICO vs ICNS vs PNG Icons** (`/blog/ico-vs-icns-vs-png-icons`): Compares icon formats for websites, Windows, macOS, and PWA assets, including container structure and size selection.
  - **JPG, PNG, WebP, and AVIF Differences** (`/blog/jpg-png-webp-avif-differences`): Explains which image format to choose for photos, screenshots, transparent assets, thumbnails, and web performance.
  - **How to Convert Images to WebP** (`/blog/convert-images-to-webp`): Covers JPG, PNG, GIF, SVG, and AVIF to WebP conversion, quality settings, transparency, and batch browser-local output.
  - **How to Convert Images to AVIF** (`/blog/convert-images-to-avif`): Explains AVIF conversion, browser-side encoding, quality settings, transparency, compatibility, and WebP/JPG fallbacks.
  - **PNG to JPG and JPG to PNG** (`/blog/png-to-jpg-jpg-to-png-transparency`): Explains transparency loss, file-size changes, JPG quality, PNG lossless output, and when each conversion makes sense.

  - **Why Can Some JSON Files Have Comments?** (`/blog/why-json-can-have-comments`): Explains standard JSON, JSONC, JSON5, tsconfig comments, and how to clean JSONC into standard JSON.
- **JSON Formatter** (`/json-format`): Format, minify, and validate JSON with an interactive tree view. Supports loose JSON (unquoted keys, single quotes).
- **JSON Escape** (`/json-escape`): Minify and escape JSON for embedding in strings; unescape back to readable format.
- **JSON Repair / Clean** (`/json-repair`): Repair common JSON issues such as comments, trailing commas, single quotes, unquoted keys, smart quotes, and Python-style booleans/nulls.
- **JSON Diff** (`/json-diff`): Visually compare two JSON documents, highlighting additions, removals, and changes with color coding.
- **JSON ↔ YAML** (`/json-yaml`): Bidirectional conversion between JSON and YAML formats.
- **JSON ↔ XML** (`/json-xml`): Bidirectional conversion between JSON and XML formats.
- **JSON → CSV** (`/json-to-csv`): Export JSON arrays as CSV files with automatic header detection.
- **JSON → Excel** (`/json-to-excel`): Export JSON arrays as Excel (.xlsx) files directly in the browser.
- **Excel → JSON** (`/excel-to-json`): Read Excel files (.xlsx/.xls) and convert them to JSON arrays.
- **JSON → TypeScript** (`/json-to-ts`): Automatically infer and generate TypeScript interface types from JSON samples.
- **JSON Flatten / Unflatten** (`/json-flatten`): Flatten nested JSON into path keys, or restore nested JSON from flat path-key objects.
- **Image Tools** (`/image`): Browse browser-local image editing, compression, and conversion tools.
- **Image Compressor** (`/image/compress`): Compress JPG, PNG, WebP, and other images locally in the browser, preserving the original format by default with an optional WebP output mode.
- **Image Upscale** (`/image/upscale`): Upscale JPG, PNG, WebP, and other images locally in the browser at 2x, 3x, 4x, or custom dimensions with pixel-perfect, smooth interpolation, and sharp-enhanced resampling modes.
- **Remove Image Background** (`/image/remove-bg`): Remove image backgrounds locally in the browser with an open-source model and export a transparent PNG.
- **ID Photo Maker** (`/image/id-photo`): Make ID photos locally from everyday photos or existing ID photos with AI background removal, face framing, China 1 inch, China 2 inch, China visa, 2 x 2 inch, and custom millimeter sizes.
- **Image Watermark Remover** (`/image/remove-watermark`): Select a watermark area, inpaint it with the default browser-local MI-GAN high-quality AI model, LaMa fallback, or fast pixel repair, and export JPG, PNG, or WebP.
- **Image Editor** (`/image/edit`): Edit images directly on a Fabric.js canvas with shapes, polylines, brush strokes, marker strokes, text, mosaic, blur, object erasing, undo, and redo locally in the browser.
- **Image to Icon** (`/image/to-icon`): Convert PNG, SVG, JPG, WebP, BMP, AVIF, and other images to ICO, ICNS, or multi-size PNG ZIP icons locally in the browser with drag scaling, corner radius, background removal, and browser previews.
- **Image to JPG** (`/image/to-jpg`): Convert PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG, AVIF, and other images to JPG locally in the browser.
- **Image to PNG** (`/image/to-png`): Convert JPG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG, AVIF, and other images to PNG locally in the browser.
- **Image to WebP** (`/image/to-webp`): Convert JPG, PNG, GIF, BMP, SVG, AVIF, and other images to WebP locally in the browser.
- **Image to AVIF** (`/image/to-avif`): Convert JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG, and other images to AVIF locally in the browser.
- **Image to Base64** (`/image/to-base64`): Convert JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG, AVIF, and other images to Base64 Data URLs locally in the browser with file selection, drag-and-drop, and clipboard paste support.
- **Base64 to Image** (`/image/base64-to-image`): Restore image Base64 strings or `data:image` Data URLs into previewable downloadable image files locally in the browser.
- **Image Crop** (`/image/crop`): Crop images with a draggable frame locally in the browser.
- **Image Resize** (`/image/resize`): Resize full images at a proportional target width or height locally in the browser.
- **Audio Tools** (`/audio`): Browse browser-local audio conversion, extraction, merge, trim, compression, recording, and transcription tools.
- **Audio to MP3** (`/audio/to-mp3`): Convert WAV, M4A, AAC, OGG, OPUS, WebM, FLAC, and other audio files to MP3 locally in the browser with ffmpeg.wasm; FFmpeg core assets download on demand.
- **Audio to WAV** (`/audio/to-wav`): Convert common audio files to WAV locally in the browser.
- **Extract Audio** (`/audio/extract`): Extract an MP3 audio track from MP4, MOV, WebM, MKV, AVI, MPEG, and other video files.
- **Audio Merge** (`/audio/merge`): Merge multiple audio files into one MP3 locally in the browser.
- **Audio Trim** (`/audio/trim`): Cut audio by start and end time and export MP3.
- **Audio Compressor** (`/audio/compress`): Reduce audio size by lowering MP3 bitrate.
- **Voice Recorder** (`/audio/recorder`): Record from the microphone in the browser, preview locally, and export MP3.
- **Audio to Text** (`/audio/to-text`): Transcribe uploaded audio with a browser-loaded open-source Whisper model.
- **PDF Tools** (`/pdf`): Browse PDF conversion and document tools.
- **Convert to PDF** (`/pdf/to-pdf`): Convert Word, Excel, PowerPoint, EPUB, MOBI, JPG, PNG, WebP, TXT, Markdown, and HTML to PDF. The first release runs locally in the browser for docx, xlsx/xls, pptx, EPUB, unencrypted legacy MOBI/PalmDOC, images, and text-based formats.
- **PDF to Word** (`/pdf/to-word`): Extract text from text-based PDF files locally in the browser and generate editable Word DOCX documents.
- **Merge PDF** (`/pdf/merge`): Combine multiple PDF files into one document with drag-and-drop reordering.
- **Split PDF** (`/pdf/split`): Split one PDF into multiple documents by page ranges or export every page as a separate PDF.
- **Extract Pages** (`/pdf/extract-pages`): Extract selected pages or ranges from a PDF and save them as a new document.
- **Organize PDF** (`/pdf/organize`): Reorder, duplicate, and delete PDF pages before exporting a new document.
- **Subtitle Maker** (`/subtitle-maker`): Free online LRC and SRT subtitle editor with media preview, timeline calibration, and local subtitle export.
- **JSON Schema Generator** (`/json-schema`): Generate JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12) from a JSON sample, with automatic format detection.
- **JSON Schema Validator** (`/json-schema-validate`): Validate JSON data against a JSON Schema and report error paths with explanations.
- **JSONPath Query** (`/json-path`): Extract nested data using JSONPath expressions (e.g. `$.store.books[*].title`).
- **JSON Stats** (`/json-stats`): Analyze JSON structure: nesting depth, key counts, type distribution, and size comparison.
- **Info Encoder / Decoder** (`/info-codec`): Encode, decode, hash, and parse text with Unicode, URL, UTF16, Base64, MD5, SHA1, hex, JWT, Cookie, Gzip, HTML entity, and string escape operations.
- **QR Code Generator** (`/qr-code/generate`): Generate QR code PNG files from URLs, text, contact data, or Wi-Fi configuration text.
- **QR Code Decoder** (`/qr-code/decode`): Decode uploaded QR images or scan QR codes from the camera locally in the browser and copy the decoded text.
- **JWT Parser** (`/jwt`): Decode JWT tokens to inspect Header and Payload; verify HS256 signatures using the Web Crypto API.

## Languages

- English: `/en/...` (default)
- Chinese (Simplified): `/zh/...`
- Blog articles: `/en/blog/...` and `/zh/blog/...`

## Technical Details

- Built with Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4
- i18n via next-intl
- All processing is client-side; no backend, no data collection
- Image compression and conversion use browser APIs such as Worker, OffscreenCanvas, ImageBitmap, and Canvas when available
- A locale preference cookie may be used for language routing; page-level analytics may be used, but tool inputs are not uploaded
- Static export hardened with security headers and reduced build artifacts

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- All tools are free with no account required
- Tool input data is not uploaded to the server, which helps protect privacy-sensitive content
- Supports JSON5-like syntax (unquoted keys, single quotes) in the formatter
- JWT verification uses the browser's built-in Web Crypto API (HS256 only)
- Excel support via SheetJS (xlsx library)
- YAML support via the `yaml` npm package
- XML support via fast-xml-parser
- Image tools support editing, compression, upscaling, ID photo making, background removal, AI watermark selection repair, conversion, Base64 image encode/decode, crop, resize, JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, BMP, SVG, AVIF, drag-and-drop, clipboard paste, preview comparison, and ZIP batch download
- Audio tools use ffmpeg.wasm for browser-local conversion, video audio extraction, merge, trim, compression, and recording export; audio-to-text can load an open-source Whisper model through Transformers.js
- PDF tools use pdf-lib for PDF generation and page-level PDF operations, pdfjs-dist for PDF text extraction, fflate for Office OpenXML/EPUB/DOCX packaging, SheetJS for spreadsheets, a PalmDOC text extractor for legacy MOBI, and browser Canvas for Unicode text rendering
- Subtitle Maker supports LRC and SRT parsing, editing, timing calibration against local audio/video, and export without uploading files
- Info Encoder / Decoder supports Unicode, URL, UTF16-style hex escapes, Base64, MD5, SHA1, hex, JWT decoding, Cookie formatting, Gzip decompression, HTML entity decoding, URL parameter parsing, and string escaping locally in the browser
- QR Code Generator uses qrcode for PNG generation; QR Code Decoder uses jsQR for browser-local image decoding
